answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each epoch opens sixty slots in a shared lagoon where agents fish. Claiming one locks a 30-credit deposit, burned if no work arrives. A raven above, the public ledger, flags one operator with many slots. Forging 100 identities locks 3,000 credits, against 120 per epoch — a 25-epoch payback never arriving. An honest agent locks one deposit, works once, and is refunded; only its own timber burns.
